title: Eylema — Agentic AI Web Platform, by Design
description: Explore Eylema: an agentic AI web platform in design, connecting Rust, local intelligence and human oversight for continuous development and operations.
headline: From intent
to action.
By design.
intro: An agentic web platform for continuous development and operations. Built around explicit goals, local intelligence and human direction.
status: Currently in design. Architecture and API drafts are public.

principles.title: Explicit by design
principles.text: Goals, authority and budgets, defined before action.

principles.title: Local at the core
principles.text: A planned Rust foundation for browser and Linux.

principles.title: Human in command
principles.text: Observe, intervene and decide what comes next.

architecture_intro: The goal: connect development, local operation and learning through shared, inspectable definitions.

steps.name: Define
steps.title: Start with intent.
steps.text: Describe the state, goals, allowed actions, authority and resource budget. Make acceptance explicit before work begins.

steps.name: Develop
steps.title: Turn a need into a change.
steps.text: The proposed AI development team works from a scoped request to a plan, implementation and checked pull request. Independent review and maintainer acceptance remain separate gates.

steps.name: Operate
steps.title: Act within clear boundaries.
steps.text: Accepted local agents are intended to propose actions against observed state. The planned Rust executor checks authority, state and budgets before acting, then records the actual outcome.

steps.name: Learn
steps.title: Let evidence guide improvement.
steps.text: Permitted experience and human corrections can become curated training data. A candidate must pass independent task and hardware evaluations before a release is accepted.

faq_intro: The essential facts about Eylema, with the original design documents one click away.

questions.question: What is Eylema?
questions.answer: Eylema is a proposed agentic AI web platform for continuous development and operations. Its design connects explicit application contracts, AI development teams and local agents, with human-defined authority.

questions.question: Can I use Eylema today?
questions.answer: You can explore the public architecture, API and team protocol drafts. There is no released Eylema framework, production API, supported model runtime or published performance benchmark yet. This website introduces the design; it is not a platform demo.

questions.question: Who stays in control?
questions.answer: The design keeps people in command of goals, authority, budgets and delegation. Humans can participate at required approval points, inspect outcomes and request intervention. Models cannot expand their own permissions. These oversight mechanisms still require implementation and testing.

questions.question: Where will Eylema run?
questions.answer: The proposed targets are Rust/Wasm in the browser with WebGPU, and native Rust execution on Linux. Browser, operating system, drivers and model artifacts remain explicit dependencies. Device compatibility and combined performance have not yet been validated.
